settings.info: Upload the full Root Access logo with wordmark. If empty, the bundled mascot and a typeset wordmark are shown.

settings.default: Houston pickup · Pick up any time, day or night

settings.label: Show "Only N left" at this many or fewer
settings.info: Every plant shows how many are left; at this many or fewer it says "Only N left" in orange. Counts only plants Shopify tracks stock for.

settings.label: Shoppers choose their plants by photo
settings.info: Product pages show one photo per plant from Plant Stock, and shoppers add the ones they tap. Turn on only once Plant Stock's plant picker is live for this store; until then Add to cart would be blocked.
